verdict.rationale: Vector quantization or compression is a fair axis for a vector database, so the story applies. The evidence pack has no documentation of quantization, compression settings, or a documented accuracy trade-off for Pinecone. The cited material covers hybrid search, filtering, multitenancy, backups, security and MCP, none of which addresses this story.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can enable vector quantization or compression to cut memory and storage cost with a documented accuracy trade-off
